designs.question: What treatment-effect patterns are supported within the 2023 reporting population?

designs.evaluation: Independent reserved episodes from both years; also report by year
designs.year_role: Categorical adjustment variable; assess discharge-year timing and coverage limitations
designs.question: What treatment-effect patterns characterize the combined reporting population after year adjustment?

designs.evaluation: Freeze 2022 rules and analysis settings before evaluating those rules in 2023
designs.question: Do the groups identified in 2022 retain similar estimated treatment effects in 2023?

comparison_rules: Apply both outcomes to every design and retain the same treatment definition.
Preserve existing 2022 partition assignments. Freeze new 2023 assignments before model selection.
Do not select a design using statistical significance or the number of significant leaves.
Keep population coverage, sample-size differences, and year differences distinguishable in reporting.
2023 is used for development in two designs; it is not an untouched project-wide validation set.
Freeze the temporal-design rules independently of the 2023-developed designs.
Forest honesty is not a substitute for independent evaluation of selected policy-tree groups.
Exported rows are not yet validated imputed model inputs; an input audit is not a fitted analysis.

execution_order.approved: Retain imputed main analysis; run complete-case sensitivity first
execution_order.imputation_status: cached categorical adapter validation in progress; production inference incomplete
execution_order.cart_primary_evaluation: User approved evaluating CART as a possible primary method; adoption remains contingent on quality, constraints and inferential validation.

screening_comparison.approval: User agreed to compare options 1 and 2 on identical training episodes.
screening_comparison.protocol: two screening settings; same 20000 training episodes, seed42, initialization, two imputations, one iteration and penalty .01; both outcomes
screening_comparison.limits: eps=0 disables all per-update remove.lindep screening, not exclusively rare-category screening. First gate measures numerical feasibility and distribution changes, not masked reconstruction accuracy or final inference.
screening_comparison.next_candidate: Explicit retention approved for imputation/inference validation; automatic screening retained as comparison. No production adoption.

execution_order.inference_validation: Small known-effect synthetic execution pilot; not validation of state-clustered MI or tree inference

cart_evaluation_evidence.finding: Both reconstruction comparisons completed. Categorical regression had lower average Brier scores across nine targets in each outcome sample. Constrained CART failed for 15 additional-substance cells; no fallback. Neither result validates primary MI inference.
cart_evaluation_evidence.main_analysis: Imputed requirement retained; no main-method adoption from this check.

reference_tree_across_imputations.primary: One reference tree per outcome and year design; development/build only; freeze before evaluation.
reference_tree_across_imputations.evaluation: Apply identical frozen rules across imputations; audit changing episode leaf membership when split variables are imputed.
reference_tree_across_imputations.stability: Separately fitted trees across imputations are stability analysis; unmatched leaves are not automatically pooled.
not_yet_resolved: Uncertainty for fixed-rule effects with imputed split variables and clustering

construction.selection_rule: Prespecified draw; never select by significance or tree appearance

state_bootstrap_validation.approval: User agreed to validate state-bootstrap candidate after state/fold support audit.
state_bootstrap_validation.scope: Small synthetic pilot retaining state adjustment; refit actual categorical imputer and nuisance estimators; not final coverage.

coverage_screen.scope: preliminary candidate coverage; no production adoption
